spec.design: Screen every pipeline using three frozen withdrawal policies (prior instant-supply winner, evaluation total winner, evaluation ongoing winner). For each seat mode and concurrency retain the total and ongoing leaders, plus the original pipeline, then search the SAME union of shortlisted pipelines for both products across all withdrawal/reserve settings. Refine around both score winners at every shortlisted pipeline, with matched product jobs. Repeat selected final policies under other budgets without retuning. Main seat mode keeps live + spares + evaluations <= 20. Separate sensitivity allows evaluations outside that cap but still limits live + activated spares to 20.
spec.note: Blocked-copying counterpart of legacy_pipeline_capacity.json: identical pipeline grid, anchors rule, shortlist rule, reserve grid and refinement; each funded account copies a signal only while flat. Anchors and controls come from the blocked eval_supply and reserve_by_policy studies and must reproduce, including per-trade account assignments.
